request.prompt: Use the supplied EXACT project ZOMBIE LORD reference as the only character design. A massive corpulent undead boss, pale gray-green mottled stitched skin, HUGE round exposed distended belly as the center of mass, tiny hunched neck and broad snarling head with sparse dark hair, very thick heavy arms and oversized bare feet. Preserve rusted nails/spikes in shoulder/back, heavy gold-rusted chains draped around neck/shoulders/chest and attached wrist shackles, ragged gray-brown skirt/loincloth, ornate antique gold pointed waist plate/belt. Both hands are EMPTY heavy fists/claws with connected chains; do not invent a sword, axe, shield, cape, horns or wings. Keep the SAME exceptional belly volume, broad shoulder/hip proportions, face, chain hardware and original muted palette in every pose. High-detail painted rendered mythic-tier fantasy RPG sprite, fixed elevated orthographic isometric camera. Non-graphic monster art: old mottled scar/stitch texture, no fresh blood or internal organs. Ignore unrelated tiny fragments at reference crop edges; reconstruct the complete top of head and full intact toes, never crop them. Draw SIX distinct RUN poses in TWO columns THREE rows in reading order. EVERY pose uses EAST strict right-facing side camera: nose/chest/knees/toes point SCREEN RIGHT; belly projects rightward. The anatomical RIGHT limbs are on the near side, LEFT on the far side. This is a very heavy grounded fast shuffle/run, NOT a slim runner or floating body. RIGHT=anatomical right bare foot, LEFT=anatomical left bare foot. Pose0 RIGHT foot reaches FORWARD and PLANTS taking weight while LEFT trails. Pose1 RIGHT leg compresses SUPPORTING, LEFT heel/toes lift and its knee bends BEHIND. Pose2 RIGHT supports, LEFT knee and whole foot swing FORWARD clearly above ground. Pose3 LEFT foot reaches FORWARD and PLANTS taking weight while RIGHT trails. Pose4 LEFT leg compresses SUPPORTING, RIGHT heel/toes lift and its knee bends BEHIND. Pose5 LEFT supports, RIGHT knee and whole foot swing FORWARD above ground ready to plant into0. The two halves MUST swap the anatomical support foot, not keep the same front leg through all6. BOTH complete bare feet and knees clearly readable below the ragged skirt; belly may obscure upper thighs but never both feet. Maintain contact with at least ONE sole in each pose. Heavy hips shift over the supporting foot, massive belly LAGS/countershifts subtly, shoulders/arms/attached chains follow with weight, not rigid whole-body translations. Chains stay heavy/attached, no detached rings. Same ONE body scale across all6; fore/aft ankle displacement is real articulation, never per-pose resizing. Each entire huge figure including head/spikes/fingers/chains/toes fits inside the CENTRAL FORTY PERCENT of its own equal cell with enormous alpha0 gutters. SIX complete connected silhouettes, one per cell, wholly disjoint bounding rectangles. No floor/shadow/grid/text/labels/specks/haze/particles. Outside bodies pure true alpha ZERO. Save local PNG.
